items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: Big Eye Louie, he came off an open circuit with a C-Mell and a saxophone.

ctx.x: I bought a Carl Fisher clarinet book. And, uh, he started me off. He started me off on a clarinet. And I went down hard practicing it. So, when my mother got sick, I comes home. When I comes home, I leave the boys out there. Well, I was right on the clarinet. Regular. Until here, Big Eye Louie, he came off an open circuit with a C-Mell and a saxophone.
You were telling me you came home, something about Big Eye Louie came. C-Mell and a saxophone. Oh, yeah. Came off the open circuit.

So, Bob Lyons, he had a shoe black stand on Ramport and Perdita. Well, that's where all the positioners' headquarters was. When they'd get up in the daytime, they'd go around Bob Lyons and have their fun. So, Bob brings me up. Old Rivers, look. Say, I want you to come over here. I got something nice I want to tell you about. I was anxious to know this about it. Come over and say, listen. Say, Big Eye Louie come in town with a saxophone. C-Mell and a saxophone. And he says that he pawned it. Yeah. Well, I go and…
